== Notes ==

* You can get a quick adrenaline boost at the start of a battle by using this skill 10-15 seconds before engaging the enemy.

{{anomaly|Similar to other skills with an [[end effect]], the end effect of Balthazar's Rage will trigger upon [[death]]. When a character who died while enchanted with Balthazar's Rage is [[Resurrection|resurrected]], the adrenaline gained from this skill's end effect will still be active on the character, instead of having no adrenaline when resurrected.}}
